runtimeCostEvidence.summary: comments and stageItemCost use item system.cost as sp-equivalent costSp; Silver Coins=1, Copper=0.1, Gold=10

notes: Only exact normalized names are treated as catalog matches. Non-identical names are catalogCandidates for user review, not equivalence.
House costs ending in sp are normalized to numeric silver and compared directly to catalog system.cost.
House cp/gp cost strings are marked exchange-decision-pending; 4x and other formula prices are manual.
House cw is recorded beside catalog unitWeight with unit-conversion-pending status; raw numeric difference alone is not a semantic conflict.
All other defined source fields are recorded with current catalog values where present.
